title: Preparation of Technical Inquiries and Suggestions for Code Revision

paragraphs.text: The ASME B31.3 Process Piping Section Committee will consider written requests for interpretations and revisions of the Code rules, and develop new rules if the committee determines it is prudent to do so. The committee’s activities in this regard are strictly limited to interpretations of the rules or to the consideration of changes to the present rules on the basis of the committee’s full understanding of new data or technology being presented by the inquirer. An inquiry that does not provide the information needed for the committee’s full understanding of the issue will be returned.

As a matter of published policy, the ASME B31.3 Process Piping Section Committee does not “approve,” “rate,” or “endorse” any item, construction, proprietary device, or activity. Inquiries requesting such consideration will be returned. Moreover, the committee does not act as a consultant on specific engineering problems or on the general application or understanding of Code rules, nor make Code recommendations. If, based on the inquiry information submitted, it is the opinion of the committee that the inquirer should seek professional assistance, the inquiry will be returned with the recommendation that such assistance be obtained.

Previously issued interpretations are available at http://go.asme.org/interpretations. The user is encouraged to use this feature to review previously published interpretations for additional understanding of the Code prior to submitting an inquiry. While this approach is timelier than submitting new inquiries, it should be used with caution because published interpretations are usually not updated based on subsequent Code revisions.
Inquiries and suggestions for Code revision shall meet the following requirements:
(a) involve a single rule or a set of closely related rules within the scope of the Code. An inquiry letter concerning unrelated subjects will be returned.

(b) be stated in a condensed and precise question-and-answer format, omitting superfluous background information, and preferably composed in such a way that a “yes” or “no” response (perhaps with provisos) would be an appropriate reply.

Inquiries shall include a proposed reply to the stated question, stating the inquirer’s understanding of what the Code requires, or alternatively a statement indicating that the inquirer is unable to determine the Code requirement. If in the inquirer’s opinion a revision to the Code is needed, recommended wording shall be suggested for the proposed Code revision.

All necessary information needed for the committee’s full understanding of the inquiry or justification for a Code revision shall be provided, including reference to the applicable edition, paragraphs, figures, and tables. The inquiry or suggested revision proposal should be technically and editorially correct. If sketches are provided, they shall be limited to the scope of the inquiry.
Inquiries and suggestions for Code revisions shall be submitted through the online Inquiry Submittal Form. The form is accessible at http://go.asme.org/ InterpretationRequest.
Other correspondence for this Code should be sent to the staff secretary noted on the committee’s web page, accessible at https://go.asme.org/B31committee.
